Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate a brand-new transparent RGBA world sprite atlas for Daoist chibi game item 五心祈愿. Input1 source phase board is STRUCTURE: only source phases[12, 13, 14] in this request. Input2 our already-made six-phase heart atlas is MATERIAL/SMALL HEART SCALE reference only, not its layout. Input3 existing inventory is our rose-jade/gold heart identity. Inputs4/5 confirmed Daoist hand-painted style.
Requested canvas1536x512, exact3columns x1rows. Each cell512square contains exactly FIVE SEPARATED heart jewels, total15 hearts. No missing/extra heart. Wide shallow, empty-centred orbit-like constellation from actual source phase. Do NOT copy a regular pentagon or a static arrangement. DO NOT draw any ring, string, trajectory, particles, extra light streaks, head, body or background.
Hearts are SMALL and plump-wide, around75pxwide x58pxhigh, fine translucent rose/salmon jade with warm-gold narrow rim and tiny integrated cloud-curl within the heart outline. Natural illustration, no plastic3D, no teardrop long points. Important: retain source native ratio of the COMPLETE five-heart OUTER visible envelope. Each constellation should be about440-450px wide but ONLY205-235px tall, according to each ratio listed. Previous tall constellations failed; draw upper and lower hearts closer and slightly smaller. This is visible group size including each jewel's extremities; transparent padding is not part of ratio.
Genuine alpha=0 must exist in all gaps, centre and outside the jewels. NO semi-transparent bronze/grey/color field, fog, halo, gold glow, shadow or vignette anywhere. Every heart whole, no contact with cell edge, >=25px fully transparent margins; no grid/text/labels.
